selection.cities: Every GeoNames Spain feature-class P record with a published population of at least 20000.

selection.astronomy: Named OpenStreetMap objects identified as astronomical observatories or planetariums. Multiple objects can describe one facility. Weather, geophysical, atmospheric, forestry and wildlife observatories are excluded.
